# SCI-MAP v0.1/r0.5 Implementation-Blind Horizontal Audit

Audit set: frozen SCI-PTC r0.5; SCI-VAL Core plus exact registered PTC/MAP
profiles; SCI-AST RTC-output-grid coordinates; SCI-MAP r0.5; and
`SCI-PTC_TO_SCI-MAP v0.1/r0.1`.

Status: clean contract-composition audit with explicit open gates; no
implementation conformity, validation, achieved response, performance,
readiness, or production authorization

| Facet | Result | Evidence / remaining condition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Identity | PASS | Exact occurrence includes observation, detector occurrence/UID, stable RTC `n`, PTC generation, segment, and group. AST joins on the same `n` and parent chain; locators and time do not establish equality. |
| Quantity | PASS | PTC transformed calibrated-`x` is named nonpolarimetric total-intensity-equivalent; `mJy/beam` carries exact nominal-beam/template lineage and does not establish Stokes I. |
| Coefficient | OPEN HARD GATE | PTC-OD-010 selects no MAP-facing family. MAP makes no default and authorizes no ordinary numerical route until selection/version binding. |
| Eligibility | PASS | PTC retention, MAP-owned `map_upstream_admission@1`, VAL registry/evaluation, and MAP numerical contribution are separate. Applicable restrictions compose conservatively; causes/scopes remain distinct. |
| Projection | PASS | `one_hot_containing_pixel@1` has exact half-open extent/boundary behavior. Fractional projection is deferred. |
| Exposure | PASS | ALIGN physical/valid-original facts are preserved; MAP use-qualified exposure unions/deduplicates original occurrences and uses one-hot/coadd placement. No count/duration/weight inference. |
| Response | PASS WITH CLAIM LIMITS | `H` is exact-class typed; PTC-grid companions begin at MAP; missing members make response limited/unavailable without changing signal membership. Full-procedure parameter/domain selection remains a response-claim gate. |
| Null space / additive reference | PASS | PTC `lambda`, fitted/total removed components, removed subspace, fixed-state null, full-procedure modes, and any bias claim remain separate. |
| Covariance | PASS WITH CLAIM LIMITS | Conditional covariance propagates on exact domains; unknown terms/blocks are not zero. Minimum persistence remains OD-004 and limits only claims requiring it. |
| Support | OPEN HARD GATE | The support formula and dimensionless `coverage_cut` identity are fixed, but OD-007 still withholds its numerical domain/admission. No support row set or general numerical route is authorized without that binding. |
| Lifecycle | PASS | Requested, effective, observation-resolved, applied, realized, and publication identities are one-way and generation-bound; new coefficient/response/covariance products do not rewrite parents. |
| Failure | PASS | Unknown/conflict/ineligible/unavailable/invalid/not-requested remain typed and scoped; required gates screen before arithmetic; bundle admission is atomic. |
| Coadd composition | PASS FOR NAMED BASE BRANCH | Uniform dimensionless coefficient and exact coadd-admission profile are defined. Centered-integer only; missing response yields an honestly response-unavailable signal coadd; unknown covariance blocks remain unknown. Crop/pad/reprojection/mosaic ownership remains outside this branch. |

## Audit Verdict

The five authorities compose without a remaining identity, quantity,
eligibility, projection, exposure, response-state, null-space, covariance-
disclosure, lifecycle, failure, or named-base-coadd contradiction. Two class-A
gates remain deliberately open: the PTC MAP-facing coefficient family and the
admitted numerical `coverage_cut` domain. Consequently the contract
architecture is coherent, but this audit does not authorize ordinary numerical
MAP production.
